message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout and the kids thought it was the best thing ever! They were giggling and making shadow puppets while I scrambled to find our flashlights. It was a little chaotic, but I ended up pulling out my trusty power bank to keep our phones charged, and we had a mini indoor camping night with snacks. Who knew that a power outage could lead to such fun? Do you have any favorite blackout activities that keep the family entertained?
